method: Synthetic image-convert, image-pdf, pdf-image, pdf-organize in one Chromium page. WeakRef observations after clear and explicit page GC; repeated independently of the matrix. Heap snapshot kept in the ignored local .cache directory.
interpretation: Transient input reference while cancelled background PDF work unwinds, not evidence of persistent accumulation. Tests now preserve immediate counts and assert zero after asynchronous cleanup within a bounded poll.
limits: Page GC/WeakRef observations do not prove all native memory was returned to the OS. No production diagnostics record document contents or filenames.
